summary: Patients love Vibes: 4.9 from 102 reviews, many from people who arrived anxious and left calm. But on Al Wasl Road you are up against a clinic with 427 five-star reviews, and every morning before 12pm, people looking for a dentist nearby can only reach your competitors.
visibility: In our searches your own website did not appear, even for your name. For "dental implants clinic Jumeirah Dubai", directories and competitors' websites took every result.
lead: Reviews describe a calm, beautiful clinic where nobody feels rushed: a powerful message for anxious patients.
Doctors and reception are praised by name (Dr. Sharief, Dr. Fatima, Shahad).
Late opening on Thursdays (until 10pm) suits working patients.
lose: Every morning until 12pm, someone with toothache nearby can only book with a competitor.
A competitor has 427 reviews to your 102, so at a glance it looks like the safer choice.
Patients who don't know you yet can't see your calm approach before they choose.

gaps.title: Your name sends patients to other clinics
gaps.detail: When we searched 'Vibes Aesthetic Clinic Dubai', a directory and pages for other clinics appeared instead of your website. Word-of-mouth referrals can leak away at that moment.

gaps.title: Morning patients go elsewhere
gaps.detail: Dental pain doesn't wait until noon. Without a way to book online 24/7, morning searchers call whichever clinic answers first.

gaps.title: Your happiest patients aren't leaving reviews
gaps.detail: You clearly delight people, yet a nearby clinic has four times as many reviews. Without an automatic review request after each visit, that gap keeps growing.

actions.title: Let patients book online, any time
actions.why: A booking page that works at 7am means morning searchers book with you instead of calling a competitor.

actions.title: Ask every happy patient for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each visit closes the review gap with the clinics around you within months.

actions.title: Send six-month check-up reminders
actions.why: Doable today with your patient list: regular reminders keep patients coming back to you.

plan.title: Your new website with 24/7 booking
plan.detail: A calm, fast site that shows your team and treatments, with online booking for every hour you're closed.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each appointment, so your happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Check-up reminders and follow-ups
plan.detail: Six-month reminders and aftercare messages that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the clinics on Al Wasl Road, and what to do next.
